content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 09 September 2026. There is no separate application form submission deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support-III position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 33,600.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Three Years Graduate degree in a relevant subject/field with three years of post-qualification experience, or a PG degree in a relevant subject/field. For Engineering/IT/CS, a Four Years Graduate Degree is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this recruitment is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Project Technical Support-III position at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and finally an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support-III recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis for the Project Technical Support-III position at AIIMS Bhopal.
